A single molotov attack on a New York church claimed as confirmation. American church arson runs to dozens of incidents a year, so one more is a weak match, and he says in the same breath that they do not want to be flaky.
New claim. He raises his own bar here: not damaged like last time but completely destroyed, which makes it harder to claim on a partial fire.
